########## I-0357 ##########
TWO WORKSPACE-LEVEL BLIND SPOTS ON THE AJCR REPRESENTABILITY CAMPAIGN (Ground, 2026-07-26).

1) THE BLUEPRINT HAS ZERO COVERAGE OF THE DD-R TOWER.
   Measured over MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild/blueprint/src/chapters/*.tex:
     DivFamZar | divFunctor | IsCertified | DivisorAdaptation | CertifiedDivisorFamily | DivRep
       -> 0 hits
     DivScheme | Grassmannian
       -> 0 hits
   That is the whole of what the last ~10 sessions produced (300+ Picard modules) and the whole
   of the certificate no-go.  Meanwhile def:pic0RepresentableByOfCharts
   (blueprint/src/chapters/PicardEtale.tex:10677) is stated conditionally on a chart family, so a
   blueprint reader concludes representability is one hypothesis away.  I-0333 already asked for
   ~5 missing nodes; nothing has been commissioned.  The blueprint and the Lean tree do not agree
   about where this project is, and the blueprint is the artifact a human reads.

2) THE LARGEST UNCLAIMED divRep-FREE BLOCK IS IN WAVE 5, NOT WAVE 4, AND IT HAS NO BRIEFING.
   AJCR.w5-av is pending 8/16 with EIGHT open leaves that all carry EMPTY summaries -- title only:
     t1 dual-number tangent kit (old-draft port)
     t3 ker(relPic(k[eps]) -> relPic(k)) =+ H^1(C,O) via nilpotent unit-lifting
     t4 the etale-plus/Zariski kernel crossing at k[eps]
     t5 dim_k T_0(d.J) = g
     s1 geometric reducedness at the identity (two-term H^2 = 0 square-zero lifting)
     s2 Smooth d.J.hom via smooth_of_grpObj
     s3 SmoothOfRelativeDimension g assembly
     p1 (blocked on DD shapes freeze)
   t1/t3/t4 mention no Jacobian at all -- they are deformation theory of relPic -- and substrate
   is already landed in AlgebraicJacobian/Tangent/ (DualNumberBaseChange, TruncExpCech,
   TruncExpCechH1, TruncExpUnits; w5-av.t2 is done).  s2/s3/t5 are datum-level, i.e. stated over a
   section variable d : JacobianData C, so they are divRep-free by construction.
   These are the frozen gates Challenge.lean:113 (SmoothOfRelativeDimension (genus C)),
   :117 (IsProper), :121 (GeometricallyIrreducible) -- the three Challenge sorries that have NO
   datum-level avatar at all (JacobianData carries only J, rep, locallyOfFiniteType, quasiCompact;
   Picard/JacobianData.lean:87-100).
   AJCR.w4-rep's summary says "work at the TOP of the mountain is available and had never been
   attempted", then points only at Wave 6.  It should point here.  Give these eight leaves
   summaries before briefing anyone on them.

########## I-0437 ##########
The B3 headlines still fire at NO datum: `FiberH1Vanishing` is unproducible because the tree has two unbridged H^1 models

Ground review of ajc-gate run 0053 s0006. The session's own frontier reading is right as far as it goes (nothing consumes the gate; `FiberH1Vanishing` has no producer) but stops one level short of the actionable cause.

VERIFIED BY GREP:
* `Scheme.Hom.FiberH1Vanishing` (`Picard/RigidPushforward.lean:279`) has exactly two declarations in the whole tree: the definition, and ONE eliminator (`Hom.FiberH1Vanishing.surjective_moduleSectionDiff`, `Cohomology/StructureSheafModuleK/QuasicoherentDegreeOneVanishing.lean:835`). No producer.
* `HasRigidPushforward` appears nowhere outside `Picard/RigidPushforward*.lean` (plus two stale comments in the root roll-up and the axiom-frontier script). At module granularity too: every cone module's only outside importer is `AlgebraicJacobian.lean`.

THE PART THAT IS NOT YET RECORDED. Every OTHER hypothesis of the B3 headlines is already producible, so `FiberH1Vanishing` is the single remaining obstruction, not one of several:
* the curve binders — `hasRigidPushforward_p1Over` (this session), and note `references/challenge.lean:42-48` imposes exactly those three hypotheses, so P^1 satisfies the challenge's COMPLETE bundle;
* `LineBundle.IsLocallyTrivial L` — `Picard/RelPicFunctor.lean:166` proves it for the structure sheaf, so `L = O` is available;
* the 2-affine cover of the fibre — `Picard/RigidPushforwardTransfer.lean:1314` (`p1BaseChangeFiberCoverSquare`);
* cover-independence — discharged (`AffineCoverMVSquare.surjective_moduleSectionDiff_of_surjective`, `QuasicoherentDegreeOneVanishing.lean:779`).

What is missing is one h^1-VANISHING COMPUTATION in the Cech model, e.g. surjectivity of `moduleSectionDiff` for `O` on the 2-chart cover of P^1_K.

AND THE TREE ALREADY HAS THE MATHEMATICS, IN THE WRONG MODEL. The adelic RiemannRoch lane has real vanishing machinery — `subsingleton_h1Mod_iff`, `subsingleton_h1Mod_peel`, `subsingleton_h1Mod_of_shift`, `h1dim_eq_zero_of_subsingleton` (`RiemannRoch/Adelic/BoundedVanishing.lean:140/167/245/255`) — stated for `h1Mod` of a Weil divisor. The B3 lane runs on `H1Cok`/`moduleSectionDiff` of an `AffineCoverMVSquare`. **No file in the tree mentions both** `h1Mod` and `H1Cok`/`moduleSectionDiff` (checked). The bridge does not exist.

HIGHEST-VALUE NEXT ACTION: build that bridge (`h1Mod D` vanishing => `FiberH1Vanishing` of the associated invertible sheaf on the fibre). It is the first producer for `FiberH1Vanishing`, it turns 17 files / ~9.4k lines of closed rigid-pushforward machinery from unconsumed into applied, and it is what makes ajc-rr's vanishing results and ajc-gate's gate meet. Until it lands, `rigidPushforward_baseChange_p1Over` and its two siblings are instantiated only in the curve argument.

########## I-0319 ##########
Lean full-build, warning and resource baseline (re-measured 2026-07-27, run 0046 sessions 0086/0088).

FROM-SCRATCH BUILD, MEASURED: wiped .lake/build, Mathlib served from the shared package cache -- ALL 8,723 jobs green in 43:15.98 wall at 9,721,288 KiB peak RSS, on a 16-core / 62 GB host contended throughout with run 0048 (load average 13-27). This supersedes the earlier 39:56.95 figure, which was taken at a different commit and before the header/import work.

THE WALL CLOCK IS CRITICAL-PATH BOUND, NOT THROUGHPUT BOUND. 68 of 165 modules finish inside 5 minutes and 113 inside 10; the last 34 take 33 minutes because the tail is an almost serial chain -- GlueDescent gates SerreTwist, GrassmannianQuot, QuotFunctorDef and RigidPushforward, which gate the Adelic lane -- and for most of that stretch exactly one project job runs. More cores buy nothing. Largest single-module costs (completion minus last dependency completion): QuotScheme 804s, TensorObjSubstrate 538s, GlueDescent 504s, Adelic/NonconstantToP1 453s, GrassmannianZariskiSheaf 385s, TensorObjInverse 360s, GrassmannianQuot 353s, CechHigherDirectImage 337s.

ROOT CAUSE IS THE UMBRELLA IMPORT, NOT THE HEARTBEATS. Measured on Cohomology/SheafCompose.lean (49 lines): 16.6 s and about 7 GB with 'import Mathlib', 3.5 s and 1.97 GB with the four precise imports the linter reports. At 7 GB per Lean process a 62 GB host sustains about 8 concurrent jobs instead of 16, so the umbrella costs wall clock twice over. Trimming maxHeartbeats ceilings saves no compute by construction.

PROGRESS TODAY: bare 'import Mathlib' 86 -> 40 of 164 modules; umbrella-free closure 32 -> 71+. Tooling in scripts/ (min-imports.sh, deumbrella.sh, deumbrella-wave.sh); the wave driver converts only modules whose whole project closure is already clean and runs a full build between waves. Conversion is NOT free by construction: GrassmannianQuot.lean times out at isDefEq (:924) and whnf (:1217) at the default 200k heartbeats WITH precise imports but builds fine with the umbrella, so a smaller environment can send a defeq check down a slower path -- every conversion re-elaborates and reverts on failure.

WARNINGS: 162 -> 24. All 102 remaining mechanical warnings were cleared (commit b0d13f686); every surviving head is a genuine 'declaration uses sorry'. Also removed 229 development-journal fragments from /-- and /-! docstrings, which doc-gen4 publishes as the project's API documentation.

RESOURCE INVENTORY UNCHANGED AND STILL OPEN: 140 maxHeartbeats, 39 synthInstance.maxHeartbeats, 15 maxSynthPendingDepth, 5 maxRecDepth scopes -- against ZERO 'set_option maxHeartbeats' in all of Mathlib/ and exactly one synthInstance budget. None of the 179 cites a measured number and Mathlib's own '#count_heartbeats in' appears nowhere in the project. Re-measure each AFTER its module leaves the umbrella. CORRECTION to an earlier suspicion: the 289 'backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency' scopes are NOT a smell -- all are per-declaration and mathl

########## I-0083 ##########
**FBC naturality leaves: precise missing layer (post-heart-closure, run 0009 T2; supersedes '4 leaf sorries' notes).** FBC has exactly **3 sorries**, all in `CechHigherDirectImageUnconditional.lean`: the two cosimplicial `naturality` fields (`cech_pushforward_baseChange_natIso` ~1690, `twisted_cech_nerve_iso` ~1758) and `pullback_preservesFiniteLimits` (197). `FlatBaseChange.lean` is sorry-free (mate stubs deleted).

- **The naturality fields are NOT quick wins.** Both components are ≪≫-chains through `pushPull_sigma_iso` + `Pi.mapIso` of per-σ isos. Missing layer, in order: (1) a transport formula expressing `(CechNerve 𝒰 F).map φ` through `pushPull_sigma_iso` as a matrix of restrictions `pushPullObj F (Over.mk j_σ) ⟶ pushPullObj F (Over.mk j_τ)` (only `pushPull_sigma_iso_π`/`_π_incl` exist, in `CechSectionIdentificationBase/Leg`); (2) per-σ restriction compatibility of the heavy per-σ isos (`pushPullObj_coverInter_baseChange`, `twisted_cech_nerve_per_sigma`) — coherence through the `AffinePushPullEssImage` essImage/adjoint constructions. Estimate: multi-hundred LOC each; one focused session per leaf at best.
- **Heart-closure recipe that landed** (session 0011 surgery, verified 0013): paste `restrictedCartesianAffinePushout` onto the ambient square (`IsPullback.paste_vert`), convert with the converse `isPushout_of_isPullback_SpecMap` (`IsPullback.of_map_of_faithful` on `Scheme.Spec`, then `.unop.flip`), identify the pullback corner with `coverInterOpen 𝒰' σ` via the slice iso, rewrite corner sections (`coverInterOpen_baseChange_restrictedMap_comm` + `pullbackRestrict_iso_tilde` + `pullback_spec_tilde_iso`), finish with `affinePushforwardPullbackBaseChange`. `set_option maxHeartbeats 800000` scoped per declaration suffices.

title: Riemann--Roch, divisors, and the adelic genus
projects:
- Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge
summary: "Riemann--Roch, divisors, and the adelic genus.

Cluster-P substrate, all\
  \ sorry-free and axiom-clean [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]:

(a) UNCONDITIONAL\
  \ class invariance (Adelic/ClassInvariance.lean) -- multiplication by g is a
 \
  \   k-linear automorphism of K(X) carrying chart sections, coboundary and overlap\
  \ onto their
    shifted counterparts, so ell, h1 and chi are functions of the\
  \ linear-equivalence class, with
    no gate, no finiteness and no ledger-exactness\
  \ input.

(b) UNCONDITIONAL degree and drop bounds (Adelic/SectionBounds.lean)\
  \ -- deg_k as a bundled
    AddMonoidHom, residue-degree positivity, positive degree\
  \ for nonzero effective divisors, and
    the drop sandwich ell(D) <= ell(D+P)\
  \ <= ell(D)+[kappa(P):k].

(c) THE CLOSED CHI-LEDGER, PROVED (Adelic/LedgerClosure.chi_eq_of_bump,\
  \ run 0055 s0008) --
    chi(D) = chi(0) + deg_k D at EVERY Weil divisor, from\
  \ the one-point bump alone. This was
    recorded as open by three sessions, with\
  \ a correct-but-irrelevant obstruction argument; the
    resolution is that hbump\
  \ admits an ARBITRARY base divisor, so the telescope runs onto the
    base D rather\
  \ than up from 0. hledger is therefore no longer an independent lane input, and
\
  \    six ledger-free restatements of the lane's conclusions are in LedgerClosure\
  \ section 2.

(d) CONDITIONAL single-field bounded H1 vanishing (Adelic/BoundedVanishing.lean)\
  \ --
    exists_bound_subsingleton_h1Mod, b = deg_k D0 + 1 - chi(0). Open inputs\
  \ now TWO, not three,
    and both are one-point local statements: the bump, and\
  \ the one-point peel. The peel is FREE
    off the overlap (peel_pointDivisor_of_notMem_overlap),\
  \ so its content sits at overlap points
    only -- a small saving, since the overlap\
  \ of a 2-affine cover of an irreducible curve is dense.

(e) PROVED global generation\
  \ (Adelic/GlobalGeneration.lean) -- the evaluation map
    Gamma(D)/Gamma(D-P)\
  \ -> kappa(P) is onto exactly when the section drop is maximal, which the
    ledger\
  \ converts into a PAIR of vanishings. Conditional on the same inputs as (d).

\
  (f) THE RESIDUE LANE, CLOSED (Adelic/ResidueField.lean) -- residueDeg = 1 and node\
  \ N14's
    residue-finiteness gate both DISCHARGED on curve hypotheses; deg_k\
  \ = deg unconditional;
    ell(D) = deg D + 1 - g for deg large on the GEOMETRIC\
  \ degree.

THE THREE GAPS, KEPT APART (the task requires this separation):
 \
  \ 1. single-field vanishing -- conditional on the bump, one base vanishing, and\
  \ the overlap peel;
  2. extension uniformity -- OPEN. UniformlyBoundedVanishing\
  \ is a definition proved at no curve.
     UniformlyBoundedVanishing' gives an\
  \ instance-binder form, defeq to it by Iff.rfl; that is a
     usability fix and\
  \ proves NOTHING about uniformity. Missing inputs unchanged: flat base change
\
  \     for the section spaces, and a WeilDivisor pullback along C_kappa -> C (hard:\
  \ points split);
  3. global generation -- PROVED, conditional on the inputs of\

summary: 'Construct picardJacobianWitness from Picard representability, the Pic0 abelian-variety
  structure, dimension g, and the Albanese universal property; discharge the protected
  Jacobian interface.  The structure is built and wired: the witness IS Scheme.Pic0Scheme,
  and 98 modules are reachable from the headline. What remains is mathematics, not
  assembly, so this item stays open with its only child done -- that status mismatch
  is deliberate.  FIVE OBLIGATIONS, measured with scripts/axiom-frontier.lean rather
  than asserted: Pic0.smooth and Pic0.proper are sorry-bodied upstream, and three
  leaves are stated at the headline. Their distances to the landed tree are now unequal
  and known:  - LEAF C (Albanese) is the closest. isAlbanese_pic0_of_isAlgClosed is
  a THEOREM: over an algebraically closed field, in positive genus, and given the
  basepoint condition, the universal property is Albanese.Pic0.albanese_universal_property
  applied with no transport. So leaf C adds exactly three things -- arbitrary base
  field (cluster G descent), genus zero (Mumford rigidity), and the basepoint condition
  P o iota_P = eta. The third is the one easily overlooked: it is a conjunct of IsAlbanese
  that the landed theorem never states, and it cannot be discharged before Pic0.abelJacobi
  is constructed, since it is a statement about that morphism.  - LEAF A (rational
  point) is not a distance at all: the statement is FALSE, so it must be replaced
  by whichever branch the owner picks in I-0372, never proved.  - LEAF B (dimension
  refinement) now has its landed half at the headline too, and it is NOT the dimension
  count. finrank_tangentSpace_pic0_eq_genus proves dim T_e Pic0 = genus C by Pic0.finrank_cotangentSpace_eq_finrank_hModuleOne
  with no transport, since genus C is definitionally dim_k H^1(C,O_C). So leaf B owes
  exactly two things: Pic0.smooth (itself unproved, so the leaf presupposes an obligation
  rather than reducing one), and a TRANSLATION between two invariants of smoothness.
  On the second: mathlib''s SmoothOfRelativeDimension mentions no tangent space, but
  it is not bridge-free -- Algebra.IsStandardSmoothOfRelativeDimension.iff_of_isStandardSmooth
  characterises relative dimension n as Module.rank S Omega[S/R] = n, an iff -- so
  the work is the duality over a field between rank Omega and the tangent-space dimension,
  plus the affine-local-to-scheme-level passage over a cover of Pic0. An earlier summary
  called this missing mathematics with no bridge; that was retracted (memory I-0446).  Pic0.smooth
  and Pic0.proper belong to no current task and are the nearest unowned work under
  the headline.'
